scripts.check: sh -c 'w=0; for s in typecheck check:rules check:no-reflect-access-live check:structural check:doc-budgets; do bun run $s; c=$?; [ $c -gt $w ] && w=$c; done; exit $w'
scripts.typecheck: sh -c 'bun run typecheck:oxlint; a=$?; bun run typecheck:structural; b=$?; [ $a -gt $b ] && exit $a; exit $b'
